anchors.description: Height of the white wall switch plate beside the doorway (standard single-gang cover plate).
anchors.visible_evidence: Small white rectangular plate on the wall right of the door frame, ~20x25 px; proportions match a US 2.75 x 4.5 in switch plate.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Blurred at distance; could be jumbo/blank cover or thermostat, so height is taken from the 4.5 in standard.

anchors.description: Outer height of the gold-framed art print hanging on the wall.
anchors.visible_evidence: Portrait gold frame with white mat and colorful print; outer vertical edges about 132 px apart; outer aspect ratio fits a standard 16x20 in framed print.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Cannot distinguish a 16x20 from a 20x24 in frame (outer height 0.56-0.66 m); mat width unknown.

anchors.description: Front-face height of the black sideboard/buffet, from its top front edge down to the floor line.
anchors.visible_evidence: Long black-lacquer buffet below the two wall frames; front face runs from the specular top front edge down to the floor shadow line at x=250.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Furniture model unknown; buffet heights typically 30-36 in, no single exact standard.
